claims: Voting for American Idol 2026 (Season 24/25) is open as of late March 2026 for the Top 14/12 rounds.
Fans can vote up to 10 times per contestant/platform at AmericanIdol.com/Vote.
Voting is available via text message to 21523.
Voting is available via new official social media voting methods on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.
The Top 14 contestants as of March 30, 2026 include Keyla Richardson, Jordan McCullough, and Kyndal Inskeep.
The Top 14 were selected for the live voting rounds following performances at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawaii.
Voting eligibility requires being 16 or older and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
Voting limit is typically 10 votes per contestant per method per voting event.
The official American Idol app is no longer used for voting.
